definitions.explanation: An organized criminal group. The official and legal term used by Japanese police and media for what is colloquially known as yakuza. These groups are the subject of extensive anti-organized-crime legislation in Japan.

examples.japanese: {暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Ties to an organized crime syndicate were discovered.

examples.japanese: {暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Anti-organized-crime ordinances are in effect nationwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構成員|こうせいいん}→構成員：15240_kouseiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}した→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧。
examples.english: The police arrested a member of an organized crime syndicate.

notes:
USAGE:
The formal and legal term for organized crime groups in Japan, used in official documents, news reports, and legislation. Colloquially, these groups are called ヤクザ. The abbreviated form {暴力|ぼうりょく}{団|だん} is sometimes further shortened to {暴|ぼう}⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ in headlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧: organized crime exclusion
- {暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}{対策法|たいさくほう}: Anti-Organized Crime Law
- {暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}⟦{構成員|こうせいいん}→構成員：15240_kouseiin⟧: gang member
- {暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧: person associated with organized crime
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}: designated crime syndicate
